solution.text: Question 14 T3 Your classmate, Leo, was absent for one of his math lessons. Explain to Leo how to determine the cosecant ratio for an angle in standard position given that ( ) P 3, 4 − − is a point on the terminal arm of the angle. Solution Method 1  Locate the point ( ) 3, 4 − − on the coordinate plane.  Draw a right-angle triangle by connecting the point ( ) 3, 4 − − to the x-axis and to the origin.  The angle created with the x-axis and the line connecting the point with the origin (the terminal arm) is θ.  Determine the length of the terminal arm by using the Pythagorean Theorem.  Once you have the lengths of all three sides of the triangle, find sinθ.  Invert the sinθ ratio to find cscθ. Method 2  Determine the value of r using the Pythagorean Theorem.  Determine the value of sin sin . y r   =     θ θ  Identify the correct quadrant.  Invert the sinθ ratio to find cscθ .
